mapper.select: WITH QTIME_INFO AS( SELECT REPLACE(LOT_ID,'.','') LOT_ID ,ROUND((to_date(substr(TARGET_TIME,0,19),'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24.MI.SS')-sysdate)*24,2) as REMAIN_QTIME ,ROUND((to_date(substr(TARGET_TIME,0,19),'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24.MI.SS')-to_date(substr(TRIGGER_TIME,0,19),'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24.MI.SS'))*24) QTIME_SPEC ,TRIGGER_MAINPD_ID,TRIGGER_OPE_NO,TRIGGER_TIME,TARGET_MAINPD_ID,TARGET_OPE_NO,TARGET_TIME FROM F2RPT.frqtime@rptdb ),LOT_INFO AS( SELECT FAB,LOCATION,LOT_ID,OPE_NO,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE ,SUBSTR(MAINPD_ID,1,INSTR(MAINPD_ID,'.')-1)ROUTE_ID , ROUND((SYSDATE-LAST_CLAIM_TIME)*24,1) DUR ,WAFER_QTY,ROUND((SYSDATE-LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME)*24,1) STAY_TIME,XFER_STATE ,PRODSPEC_ID,NENG_FLAG FROM ODS.V_LOT WHERE LOT_INV_STATE = 'OnFloor' AND LOT_PROC_STATE IN('OnHold','Waiting') AND SUBSTR(MAINPD_ID,1,2) ='YY' AND PW_FLAG =1 AND NENG_FLAG =1 AND SUBSTR(OPE_NO,-2,2) = '1R' AND (SYSDATE-LAST_CLAIM_TIME)>0.5 ),HOLD_INFO AS( SELECT LOT_ID,RESPONSIBLE_OPE_NO,MODULE,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,RESPONSIBLE_OPE_NO,CLAIM_TIME,MODULE,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO ,ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY LOT_ID ORDER BY CLAIM_TIME DESC)RN FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,RESPONSIBLE_OPE_NO,CLAIM_TIME,MODULE,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO FROM ODS.HOLD_DETAIL_HISTORY WHERE HOLD_TYPE <> 'BankHold' AND RELEASE_TIME IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT LOT_ID,RESPONSIBLE_OPE_NO,CLAIM_TIME,MODULE,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO FROM ODS.HOLD_DETAIL_HISTORY@TO_A3_PDW WHERE HOLD_TYPE <> 'BankHold' AND RELEASE_TIME IS NULL )A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,LOCATION,FAB FROM LOT_INFO WHERE LOT_PROC_STATE = 'OnHold' )B WHERE A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID ))WHERE RN=1 ),PATH_INFO AS( SELECT LOT_ID,OPE_NO,LOCATION ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A12_MFG_FLAG ='Y' AND A12_PRC_FLAG='Y' THEN A12_EQP END)A12_COUNT ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A3_MFG_FLAG ='Y' AND A3_PRC_FLAG='Y' THEN A3_EQP END)A3_COUNT ,TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A12_MFG_FLAG ='Y' AND A12_PRC_FLAG='Y' THEN A12_EQP END))A12_PATH ,TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A3_MFG_FLAG ='Y' AND A3_PRC_FLAG='Y' THEN A3_EQP END))A3_PATH FROM( SELECT A.LOCATION, A.LOT_ID,A.OPE_NO,A.ROUTE_ID ,B.EQUIPMENTID A12_EQP ,B.PASS_FLG_MFG A12_MFG_FLAG,B.PASS_FLG_PRC A12_PRC_FLAG ,C.EQUIPMENTID A3_EQP ,C.PASS_FLG_MFG A3_MFG_FLAG,C.PASS_FLG_PRC A3_PRC_FLAG FROM LOT_INFO A LEFT JOIN MM.CSFRINHIBIT B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = B.PRODUCTID AND A.ROUTE_ID = B.ROUTEID AND A.OPE_NO = B.OPENO LEFT JOIN MM.CSFRINHIBIT@TO_A3_PDW C ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = C.PRODUCTID AND A.ROUTE_ID = C.ROUTEID AND A.OPE_NO = C.OPENO )GROUP BY LOT_ID,OPE_NO,LOCATION ),FOUP_LOT_INFO AS( SELECT 'N1A1' LOCATION, CAST_ID,LOT_ID FROM MM.FVCAST_LOT A WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM( SELECT LOT_ID FROM LOT_INFO WHERE LOCATION = 'N1A1' )B WHERE REPLACE(A.LOT_ID,'.','') = B.LOT_ID ) UNION ALL SELECT 'N1A3' LOCATION, CAST_ID,LOT_ID FROM MM.FVCAST_LOT@TO_A3_PDW A WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM( SELECT LOT_ID FROM LOT_INFO WHERE LOCATION = 'N1A3' )B WHERE REPLACE(A.LOT_ID,'.','') = B.LOT_ID ) ),MULTILOT_INFO AS( SELECT CAST_ID,LOT_COUNT,CASE WHEN LOT_COUNT>1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END MULTILOT_FLAG FROM( SELECT CAST_ID,COUNT(1)LOT_COUNT FROM( SELECT CAST_ID,LOT_ID FROM MM.FVCAST_LOT C WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM( SELECT DISTINCT CAST_ID FROM FOUP_LOT_INFO WHERE LOCATION = 'N1A1' )D WHERE C.CAST_ID = D.CAST_ID ) UNION ALL SELECT CAST_ID,LOT_ID FROM MM.FVCAST_LOT@TO_A3_PDW C WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM( SELECT DISTINCT CAST_ID FROM FOUP_LOT_INFO WHERE LOCATION = 'N1A3' )D WHERE C.CAST_ID = D.CAST_ID ))GROUP BY CAST_ID )) SELECT FAB,LOCATION,LOT_ID,OPE_NO,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE ,ROUTE_ID,DUR,WAFER_QTY,STAY_TIME,XFER_STATE,PRODSPEC_ID,NENG_FLAG ,PRODG1,TECH,REMAIN_QTIME,QTIME_SPEC,LOT_PRIORITY,COMMIT_DATE2,MODULE ,HOLD_MODULE,HOLD_COMMENT,STATE,CAST_ID,MULTILOT_FLAG ,A12_COUNT,A12_PATH,A3_COUNT,A3_PATH FROM( SELECT A.*,B.PRODG1,C.MFG_TECH TECH ,D.REMAIN_QTIME,D.QTIME_SPEC,E.LOT_PRIORITY ,E.COMMIT_DATE2,PWEB.GET_MODULE(A.MAINPD_ID,A.OPE_NO)MODULE ,F.MODULE HOLD_MODULE,F.HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO HOLD_COMMENT , CASE WHEN E.LOT_PRIORITY>=0 AND E.LOT_PRIORITY<=299 THEN '严重Delay' WHEN E.LOT_PRIORITY>=300 AND E.LOT_PRIORITY<=499 THEN 'Delay' WHEN E.LOT_PRIORITY>499 THEN '安全' ELSE '' END STATE ,H.CAST_ID ,I.MULTILOT_FLAG ,G.A12_COUNT,G.A12_PATH,G.A3_COUNT,G.A3_PATH FROM LOT_INFO A LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = B.PRODSPEC_ID LEFT JOIN A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_INFO C ON B.PRODG1 = C.PRODG1 LEFT JOIN QTIME_INFO D ON A.LOT_ID = D.LOT_ID LEFT JOIN PWEB.A3_LOT_PRIORITY E ON A.LOT_ID = E.LOT_ID LEFT JOIN HOLD_INFO F ON A.LOT_ID = F.LOT_ID LEFT JOIN PATH_INFO G ON A.LOT_ID = G.LOT_ID LEFT JOIN FOUP_LOT_INFO H ON A.LOT_ID = REPLACE(H.LOT_ID,'.','') LEFT JOIN MULTILOT_INFO I ON H.CAST_ID = I.CAST_ID )ORDER BY DECODE(MODULE,'PHOTO',1,'ETCH',2,'TF',3,'DIFF',4,'WET',5,'CMP',6,7),DUR DESC
SELECT EMAIL FROM workflow.hr_users WHERE bywork='0' and quit_date is NULL AND DEPT_ID=#{deptid} AND TITLE NOT LIKE '%部经理%'
SELECT EMAIL FROM workflow.hr_users WHERE bywork='0' and quit_date is NULL AND DEPT_ID=#{deptid} AND DIRECT='间' AND SDEPT_CNAME NOT LIKE '%资源课%' ORDER BY SDEPT_CNAME

SELECT PRODG1,DEPT_ID FROM ( SELECT E.PRODG1,E.CHIPBODY,E.OPER_NO,E.EQP_G,E.MODULE,E.MFG_EQP_ID,E.PATHS_LIST,E.FOLLOW_RATE ,NVL(NVL(F.DEPT_ID,I.DEPT_ID),H.DEPT_ID) DEPT_ID FROM ( SELECT A.* ,CASE WHEN SUBSTR(C.DEPT_ID1,1,2) IN ('RI','RH') THEN 'TD' WHEN SUBSTR(C.DEPT_ID1,1,2) IN ('TD','TA') THEN 'RD' END PROD_TYPE FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_SUM A LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT_OWNER C ON A.PRODG1=C.PRODG1 WHERE ((A.TYPE ='非ETCH Chamber' AND A.FOLLOW_RATE=0) OR (A.TYPE ='ETCH Chamber' AND A.FOLLOW_RATE<100)) AND A.PRODG1 IN ( SELECT PRODG FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN WHERE FLAG='Y' AND IF_INPUTOVER200_FLAG='是' AND TD_UPDATE_USER='SYS' ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAIL WHERE TYPE='OVER200_TO_MODULE')B WHERE A.PRODG1=B.PRODG1 AND A.DEPT_ID=B.DEPT_ID) )E LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.TD_RD_RELATED_MODULE WHERE MODULE IS NOT NULL)F ON E.PROD_TYPE=F.PROD_TYPE AND E.MODULE=F.MODULE LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.TD_RD_RELATED_MODULE WHERE MODULE IS NULL AND OPER_NO IS NULL)I ON E.PROD_TYPE=I.PROD_TYPE AND E.EQP_G=I.EQP_G LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.TD_RD_RELATED_MODULE WHERE MODULE IS NULL AND OPER_NO IS NOT NULL)H ON E.PROD_TYPE=H.PROD_TYPE AND E.EQP_G=H.EQP_G AND SUBSTR(E.OPER_NO,4,3)=H.OPER_NO ) GROUP BY PRODG1,DEPT_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT E.PRODG1,E.CHIPBODY,E.OPER_NO,E.EQP_G,E.MODULE,E.MFG_EQP_ID,E.PATHS_LIST,E.FOLLOW_RATE,E.OPER_SEQ ,NVL(NVL(F.DEPT_ID,I.DEPT_ID),H.DEPT_ID) DEPT_ID FROM ( SELECT A.* ,CASE WHEN SUBSTR(C.DEPT_ID1,1,2) IN ('RI','RH') THEN 'TD' WHEN SUBSTR(C.DEPT_ID1,1,2) IN ('TD','TA') THEN 'RD' END PROD_TYPE FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_SUM A LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT_OWNER C ON A.PRODG1=C.PRODG1 WHERE ((A.TYPE ='非ETCH Chamber' AND A.FOLLOW_RATE=0) OR (A.TYPE ='ETCH Chamber' AND A.FOLLOW_RATE<100)) AND A.PRODG1 IN ( SELECT PRODG FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN WHERE FLAG='Y' AND IF_INPUTOVER200_FLAG='是' AND TD_UPDATE_USER='SYS' ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAIL WHERE TYPE='OVER200_TO_MODULE')B WHERE A.PRODG1=B.PRODG1 AND A.DEPT_ID=B.DEPT_ID) )E LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.TD_RD_RELATED_MODULE WHERE MODULE IS NOT NULL)F ON E.PROD_TYPE=F.PROD_TYPE AND E.MODULE=F.MODULE LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.TD_RD_RELATED_MODULE WHERE MODULE IS NULL AND OPER_NO IS NULL)I ON E.PROD_TYPE=I.PROD_TYPE AND E.EQP_G=I.EQP_G LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.TD_RD_RELATED_MODULE WHERE MODULE IS NULL AND OPER_NO IS NOT NULL)H ON E.PROD_TYPE=H.PROD_TYPE AND E.EQP_G=H.EQP_G AND SUBSTR(E.OPER_NO,4,3)=H.OPER_NO ) WHERE PRODG1 =#{prodg} AND DEPT_ID=#{deptid} ORDER BY PRODG1,OPER_SEQ

SELECT H.PRODG1,H.DEPT_ID FROM (SELECT E.*,F.DEPT_ID FROM (SELECT D.* ,CASE WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' AND D.EQP_G IN ('QC_OCD','QC_THK','QC_THK_Cu','QC_THK_Si','QC_Trim','QW_SEM-ET','QW_SEM-PH') THEN '量测生产课' WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' AND D.EQP_G IN ('QA_AEI_CMP','QA_AFM','QB_Bubble','QB_Bubble_STK') THEN D.FAB||'洗磨生产课' WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' AND D.EQP_G IN ('QA_ADI','QX_Overly') THEN D.FAB||'黄光生产课' WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' AND D.EQP_G IN ('QA_AEI','QG_Defect','QP_Defect') THEN D.FAB||'蚀刻生产课' WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' AND D.EQP_G IN ('QY_D.PC','QS_SEM','QZ_Defect') THEN D.FAB||'薄膜生产课'
WHEN D.MODULE='PHOTO' THEN D.FAB||'黄光生产课' WHEN D.MODULE='TF' THEN D.FAB||'薄膜生产课' WHEN D.MODULE='ETCH' THEN D.FAB||'蚀刻生产课' WHEN D.MODULE='DIFF' THEN D.FAB||'扩散生产课' WHEN --D.FAB='A12' AND D.MODULE IN ('CMP','WET') THEN D.FAB||'洗磨生产课' --WHEN D.FAB='A3' AND D.MODULE IN ('WET') THEN '扩散生产课' --WHEN D.FAB='A3' AND D.MODULE IN ('CMP') THEN '薄膜生产课' END SDEPT_CNAME FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN C.MODULE='Measurement' AND C.EQP_G IN ('QC_OCD','QC_THK','QC_THK_Cu','QC_THK_Si','QC_Trim','QW_SEM-ET','QW_SEM-PH') THEN 'A12' ELSE A.FAB END FAB ,A.PRODG1,A.EQP_G ,CASE WHEN A.EQP_G IN ('WR_Metal_cln','WRA_Al film RMV','WRC_Cu Remove','WRM_Ox-SiN/PD_Cln(Before)','WRM_Ox-SiN_Cln(After)','WRO_Ox-SiN Cln(Before)' ,'WRP_P/D cln(After)','WRP_P/D cln(Before)','WS_FOUP Cln','FA_Oxi(After)','FA_Oxi(Before)','FA_Oxi(Cu)') THEN 'NPW' ELSE C.MODULE END MODULE ,B.EQP_ID FROM ( SELECT T1.PRODG1,T1.EQP_G,T2.FAB FROM PWEB.WP_PRODG_FLOW T1,(SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN WHERE FLAG='Y' AND FAB IS NOT NULL)T2 WHERE T1.PRODG1=T2.PRODG )A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.NTO_MFG_MAINTAIN B ON A.PRODG1=B.PRODG AND A.EQP_G=B.EQP_G LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MODULE,EQP_G FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD)C ON A.EQP_G=C.EQP_G)D WHERE D.MODULE NOT IN ('FA','INT','NPW') AND D.EQP_ID IS NULL)E LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN DEPT_ID IN ('PB11','PT11') THEN 'A12' WHEN DEPT_ID='PH11' THEN 'A3' END FAB,SDEPT_CNAME,SUBDEPT_ID ,CASE WHEN DEPT_ID='PT11' THEN DEPT_ID||'-'||SUBDEPT_ID ELSE DEPT_ID||'-'||SUBDEPT_ID||'2' END DEPT_ID FROM WORKFLOW.HR_USERS WHERE BYWORK='0' AND QUIT_DATE IS NULL AND DEPT_ID IN ('PH11','PB11','PT11') AND SDEPT_CNAME IS NOT NULL)F ON E.FAB=F.FAB AND E.SDEPT_CNAME=F.SDEPT_CNAME)H WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAIL WHERE TYPE='MAINTAIN_TO_MODULE')B WHERE H.PRODG1=B.PRODG1 AND H.DEPT_ID=B.DEPT_ID) GROUP BY H.PRODG1,H.DEPT_ID

SELECT H.* FROM (SELECT E.*,F.DEPT_ID FROM (SELECT D.* ,CASE WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' THEN '量测生产课' --WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' AND D.EQP_G IN ('QC_OCD','QC_THK','QC_THK_Cu','QC_THK_Si','QC_Trim','QW_SEM-ET','QW_SEM-PH') THEN '量测生产课' --WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' AND D.EQP_G IN ('QA_AEI_CMP','QA_AFM','QB_Bubble','QB_Bubble_STK') THEN D.FAB||'洗磨生产课' --WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' AND D.EQP_G IN ('QA_ADI','QX_Overly') THEN D.FAB||'黄光生产课' --WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' AND D.EQP_G IN ('QA_AEI','QG_Defect','QP_Defect') THEN D.FAB||'蚀刻生产课' --WHEN D.MODULE='Measurement' AND D.EQP_G IN ('QY_D.PC','QS_SEM','QZ_Defect') THEN D.FAB||'薄膜生产课'
WHEN D.MODULE='PHOTO' THEN D.FAB||'黄光生产课' WHEN D.MODULE='TF' THEN D.FAB||'薄膜生产课' WHEN D.MODULE='ETCH' THEN D.FAB||'蚀刻生产课' WHEN D.MODULE='DIFF' THEN D.FAB||'扩散生产课' WHEN --D.FAB='A12' AND D.MODULE IN ('CMP','WET') THEN D.FAB||'洗磨生产课' --WHEN D.FAB='A3' AND D.MODULE IN ('WET') THEN '扩散生产课' --WHEN D.FAB='A3' AND D.MODULE IN ('CMP') THEN '薄膜生产课' END SDEPT_CNAME FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN C.MODULE='Measurement' --AND C.EQP_G IN ('QC_OCD','QC_THK','QC_THK_Cu','QC_THK_Si','QC_Trim','QW_SEM-ET','QW_SEM-PH') THEN 'A12' ELSE A.FAB END FAB ,A.PRODG1,A.EQP_G ,CASE WHEN A.EQP_G IN ('WR_Metal_cln','WRA_Al film RMV','WRC_Cu Remove','WRM_Ox-SiN/PD_Cln(Before)','WRM_Ox-SiN_Cln(After)','WRO_Ox-SiN Cln(Before)' ,'WRP_P/D cln(After)','WRP_P/D cln(Before)','WS_FOUP Cln','FA_Oxi(After)','FA_Oxi(Before)','FA_Oxi(Cu)') THEN 'NPW' ELSE C.MODULE END MODULE ,B.EQP_ID FROM ( SELECT T1.PRODG1,T1.EQP_G,T2.FAB FROM PWEB.WP_PRODG_FLOW T1,(SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN WHERE FLAG='Y' AND FAB IS NOT NULL)T2 WHERE T1.PRODG1=T2.PRODG )A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.NTO_MFG_MAINTAIN B ON A.PRODG1=B.PRODG AND A.EQP_G=B.EQP_G LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MODULE,EQP_G FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD)C ON A.EQP_G=C.EQP_G)D WHERE D.MODULE NOT IN ('FA','INT','NPW') AND D.EQP_ID IS NULL)E LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN DEPT_ID IN ('PB11','PT11') THEN 'A12' WHEN DEPT_ID='PH11' THEN 'A3' END FAB,SDEPT_CNAME,SUBDEPT_ID ,CASE WHEN DEPT_ID='PT11' THEN DEPT_ID||'-'||SUBDEPT_ID ELSE DEPT_ID||'-'||SUBDEPT_ID||'2' END DEPT_ID FROM WORKFLOW.HR_USERS WHERE BYWORK='0' AND QUIT_DATE IS NULL AND DEPT_ID IN ('PH11','PB11','PT11') AND SDEPT_CNAME IS NOT NULL )F ON E.FAB=F.FAB AND E.SDEPT_CNAME=F.SDEPT_CNAME)H WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAIL WHERE TYPE='MAINTAIN_TO_MODULE')B WHERE H.PRODG1=B.PRODG1 AND H.DEPT_ID=B.DEPT_ID) AND H.PRODG1=#{prodg} AND H.DEPT_ID=#{deptid}

SELECT E.PRODG1,'PA10' DEPTID FROM (SELECT PRODG1,CNT_NULL/CNT RATIO FROM (SELECT T1.PRODG1,COUNT(CASE WHEN EQP_G IS NULL THEN PRODG1 ELSE NULL END) CNT_NULL,COUNT(*) CNT FROM PWEB.WP_PRODG_FLOW T1 ,(SELECT PRODG FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN WHERE FLAG='Y' AND FAB IS NOT NULL AND IF_INPUTOVER200_FLAG IS NOT NULL)T2 WHERE T1.PRODG1 =T2.PRODG GROUP BY T1.PRODG1))E WHERE E.RATIO>0.8 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAIL F WHERE E.PRODG1=F.PRODG1 AND F.DEPT_ID='PA10' AND F.TYPE='MAIL_TO_OPD')

SELECT * FROM (SELECT T3.*,T4.EMAIL FROM ( SELECT PRODG1,CONTACT1_CNAME,DEPT_ID1 DEPT_ID FROM ( SELECT T1.*,T2.CONTACT1_CNAME,T2.DEPT_ID1,T4.PRODUCT_STATUS,T4.CT_G,T5.PLATFORM_NICKNAME FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT PRODG1 FROM PWEB.PRODUCT_HISTORY A WHERE A.SHIFT_DATE=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PRODG1 FROM PWEB.PRODUCT_HISTORY WHERE SHIFT_DATE=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD'))B WHERE A.PRODG1=B.PRODG1 ) AND SUBSTR(PRODG1,1,3) NOT IN ('L11','L15','L90') AND PRODG1 NOT LIKE 'P15AE%' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN C WHERE A.PRODG1=C.PRODG) )T1 LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT_OWNER T2 ON T1.PRODG1=T2.PRODG1 LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT_INFO T4 ON T1.PRODG1=T4.PRODG1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT B.PRODG1,A.PLATFORM_NICKNAME FROM PWEB.product_platform A,PWEB.PRODUCT B WHERE A.PRODSPEC_ID =B.PRODSPEC_ID )T5 ON T1.PRODG1=T5.PRODG1 ) WHERE SUBSTR(DEPT_ID1,1,2) IN ('RH','RI','TD','TA') AND PRODUCT_STATUS='Pilot' AND CT_G <>'NSC' AND PLATFORM_NICKNAME IS NOT NULL )T3 LEFT JOIN WORKFLOW.HR_USERS T4 ON T3.CONTACT1_CNAME=T4.CNAME AND T3.DEPT_ID=T4.DEPT_ID) WHERE EMAIL IS NOT NULL
